visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at an ancient archaeological site with stone arches and ruins in the background under bright, clear daylight. Four young men stand in a group; the central figure wears a black long-sleeve shirt and beige shorts, while the others wear casual t-shirts and bright shorts. They have towels draped over their shoulders and are wearing sunglasses, looking directly at the camera with neutral expressions. White text overlays are visible at the top. (2) The scene transitions to a reference image labeled 'POSE 1' showing four trendy individuals, then cuts back to the four men mimicking the pose. They hold their sunglasses or frame their eyes with their fingers, standing in a line. The background remains the sun-drenched ruins with sparse grass. (3) A new reference image labeled 'POSE 2' appears showing a heart formed by arms on a mountain, followed by the four men attempting this. They bend their bodies and arms to form a large collective heart shape against the backdrop of the ancient stone structure. (4) Transitioning to 'POSE 3', a reference photo shows a giant stepping over others; the men then replicate this with one man in red shorts lifting his leg high as if stepping over his three friends who are positioned further back to create a forced perspective effect. (5) 'POSE 4' shows a reference of hands forming a star, and the video cuts to a top-down view of the four men's hands meeting in the center to create a star shape with their fingers over the stone-paved ground. (6) The final phase 'POSE 5' shows a reference of two people hugging and lifting, then cuts to the four men in a row, hugging each other's waists and lifting their outside legs in a playful, coordinated group hug pose.
